Theorem
[flatness from Ricci pinching in the noncompact three-dimensional case] Source: cao-zhu 1. Theorem 5.2.10\group Differentiable Sphere Theorems

Let $M$ be a three-dimensional complete noncompact Riemannian manifold with bounded and nonnegative sectional curvature. Suppose $M$ satisfies the following Ricci pinching condition \[ R_{ij}\ge \varepsilon Rg_{ij},\quad \text{on }\; M, \] for some $\varepsilon >0$. Then $M$ is flat.
